name: journalctl
description: Print log entries from the systemd journal

options.name: --system
options.description: Show the system journal

options.name: --user
options.description: Show the user journal for the current user

name: -M
--machine
options.description: Operate on local container

name: -m
--merge
options.description: Show entries from all available journals

name: -D
--directory
options.description: Show journal files from directory

name: -i
--file
options.description: Show journal file

options.name: --root
options.description: Operate on an alternate filesystem root

options.name: --image
options.description: Operate on disk image as filesystem root

options.name: --image-policy
options.description: Specify disk image dissection policy

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Show journal data from specified journal namespace

name: -S
--since
options.description: Show entries not older than the specified date

name: -U
--until
options.description: Show entries not newer than the specified date

name: -c
--cursor
options.description: Show entries starting at the specified cursor

options.name: --after-cursor
options.description: Show entries after the specified cursor

options.name: --cursor-file
options.description: Show entries after cursor in FILE and update FILE

name: -b
--boot
options.description: Show current boot or the specified boot

name: -u
--unit
options.description: Show logs from the specified unit

options.name: --user-unit
options.description: Show logs from the specified user unit

options.name: --invocation
options.description: Show logs from the matching invocation ID

options.name: -I
options.description: Show logs from the latest invocation of unit

name: -t
--identifier
options.description: Show entries with the specified syslog identifier

name: -T
--exclude-identifier
options.description: Hide entries with the specified syslog identifier

name: -p
--priority
options.description: Show entries within the specified priority range

options.name: --facility
options.description: Show entries with the specified facilities

name: -g
--grep
options.description: Show entries with MESSAGE matching PATTERN

name: -k
--dmesg
options.description: Show kernel message log from the current boot

name: -o
--output
options.description: Change journal output mode (short, short-precise

options.name: --output-fields
options.description: Select fields to print in verbose/export/json modes

name: -n
--lines
options.description: Number of journal entries to show

name: -r
--reverse
options.description: Show the newest entries first

options.name: --show-cursor
options.description: Print the cursor after all the entries

options.name: --utc
options.description: Express time in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

name: -x
--catalog
options.description: Add message explanations where available

name: -W
--no-hostname
options.description: Suppress output of hostname field

options.name: --no-full
options.description: Ellipsize fields

name: -a
--all
options.description: Show all fields, including long and unprintable

name: -f
--follow
options.description: Follow the journal

options.name: --no-tail
options.description: Show all lines, even in follow mode

options.name: --truncate-newline
options.description: Truncate entries by first newline character

name: -q
--quiet
options.description: Do not show info messages and privilege warning

options.name: --synchronize-on-exit
options.description: Wait for Journal synchronization before exiting

options.name: --no-pager
options.description: Do not pipe output into a pager

name: -e
--pager-end
options.description: Immediately jump to the end in the pager

options.name: --interval
options.description: Time interval for changing the FSS sealing key

options.name: --verify-key
options.description: Specify FSS verification key

options.name: --force
options.description: Override of the FSS key pair with --setup-keys

name: -h
--help
options.description: Show this help text

options.name: --version
options.description: Show package version

name: -N
--fields
options.description: List all field names currently used

name: -F
--field
options.description: List all values that a specified field takes

options.name: --list-boots
options.description: Show terse information about recorded boots

options.name: --list-invocations
options.description: Show invocation IDs of specified unit

options.name: --list-namespaces
options.description: Show list of journal namespaces

options.name: --disk-usage
options.description: Show total disk usage of all journal files

options.name: --vacuum-size
options.description: Reduce disk usage below specified size

options.name: --vacuum-files
options.description: Leave only the specified number of journal files

options.name: --vacuum-time
options.description: Remove journal files older than specified time

options.name: --verify
options.description: Verify journal file consistency

options.name: --sync
options.description: Synchronize unwritten journal messages to disk

options.name: --relinquish-var
options.description: Stop logging to disk, log to temporary file system

options.name: --smart-relinquish-var
options.description: Similar, but NOP if log directory is on root mount

options.name: --flush
options.description: Flush all journal data from /run into /var

options.name: --rotate
options.description: Request immediate rotation of the journal files

options.name: --header
options.description: Show journal header information

options.name: --list-catalog
options.description: Show all message IDs in the catalog

options.name: --dump-catalog
options.description: Show entries in the message catalog

options.name: --update-catalog
options.description: Update the message catalog database

options.name: --setup-keys
options.description: Generate a new FSS key pair
